feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no result is stated for it. The candidate is the iteration 7 design, which iteration 9 reproduced at 216.97 under the same seeds, so that result is confirmed. The one change is base_speed 1.6 to 1.7, with every other field as in iteration 7 (kp 3.0, ki 1.0, kd 0.5, outer sensors at x = ±0.04, sensor_size 0.016, last_direction). Iteration 2 showed that lowering base_speed to 1.2 cut oval finishes from 5/20 to 0/20 and lowered the score, so a modest rise is the more plausible direction. Oval mean finish time was 1.93 s at 1.6 in iteration 7, which leaves ample margin under the 3.0 s limit at 1.7. Earlier races rule out wider outer sensors (iteration 3), higher kp (iteration 4) and higher ki (iteration 8, which scored 187.18 at ki 1.2). The main risk is bend drift at higher speed, so s-bend progress and max_error are the watch items. This is approved because it is a single-variable test of the one lever not yet tried, and the iteration 7 design is a known fallback. After the race, compare the score with 216.97. If the score is at or above 216.97 with s-bend progress at or above 0.46 and max_error at or below about 0.063 m, the next iteration may try base_speed 1.8 as a single further step, while checking that oval completion_time stays well under 3.0 s. If the score falls below 216.97, or s-bend or slalom progress drops, or steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35, return base_speed to 1.6 and submit the iteration 7 design unchanged. Do not change kd or ki in that next step, since kd 0.5 and ki 1.0 are the current best values.
requested_changes: If the race scores at or above 216.97 with s-bend progress at or above 0.46 and max_error at or below about 0.063 m: try base_speed 1.8 with all other fields as in this candidate, and confirm oval completion_time stays well under 3.0 s.

If the race scores below 216.97, or s-bend or slalom progress falls, or steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35: return base_speed to 1.6 and submit the iteration 7 design (kp 3.0, ki 1.0, kd 0.5, base_speed 1.6, outer sensors at x = ±0.04, sensor_size 0.016, last_direction) unchanged.
Do not change kd above 0.5 or ki above 1.0 without new evidence, since iteration 8 showed ki 1.2 lowered the score and iteration 5 showed kd 0.5 is the best damping tested.
